### Executed Code:
```python
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import rdMolDescriptors
s='O=C(NCC(O)c1cccc(F)c1)c1ccc(Br)cc1Cl'
m=Chem.MolFromSmiles(s)
print('Parsed:', m is not None)
print('Formula:', rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(m))
print('Atom counts:', {a: sum(1 for x in m.GetAtoms() if x.GetSymbol()==a) for a in ['C','H','N','O','F','Cl','Br']})
```
